title: Sebastian and the Room
author: M. M. Vasquez
blurb: Vesper Eriksen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
